::: {.lede}
Independent studies and applied research I am running now — several with students.
:::

These are works in progress. Where one turns into a paper or a dataset, I link it
from the [Publications](research.qmd) page.

::: {.pub}
[Independent study · Spring 2026 – present]{.pub-venue}
[Developer–AI Augmentation in Software Development]{.pub-title}

::: {.pub-authors}
How AI is shifting software development from writing code to specifying intent:
human–AI collaboration models, their effect on developer workflows and cognition,
and the trade-offs between efficiency gains and risks such as overreliance, reduced
code comprehension, and security vulnerabilities in generated output.
:::
:::

::: {.pub}
[Independent study · Spring 2026]{.pub-venue}
[Edge AI vs. Cloud AI: Performance, Latency, and Hybrid System Design]{.pub-title}

::: {.pub-authors}
A comparative analysis of Edge AI and Cloud AI architectures — latency, scalability,
bandwidth, and data privacy — anchored in a Remaining Useful Life prediction task
on the NASA C-MAPSS dataset, working toward hybrid Edge–Cloud designs.
:::
:::

::: {.pub}
[Independent study · Fall 2025 – present]{.pub-venue}
[Data-Driven Soccer Analytics: Performance Determinants of Winning]{.pub-title}

::: {.pub-authors}
Match-level analysis of Brockport women's soccer to find what separates wins from
non-wins — possession, territorial control, and attacking output — and the
performance thresholds tied to a higher chance of winning.
:::
:::

::: {.pub}
[Independent study · Fall 2023 – present]{.pub-venue}
[Analyzing Engagement and Growth in YouTube's Creator Economy]{.pub-title}

::: {.pub-authors}
How digital creators build audiences and monetize social capital: analyzing
YouTube video data, descriptions, comments, and community engagement to inform
data-driven content strategy.
:::
:::
